title: Padding an auxiliary assignment
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be nonnegative integers with $a\le K$, and let an assignment give a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each of $a$ auxiliary coordinates. Its padding to $K$ coordinates agrees with that assignment on the first $a$ coordinates and is constantly $-1$ on the remaining coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of signs to $a$ auxiliary coordinates
